sources.provider: Purdue University official campus building footprint FeatureServer layer 0
sources.role: Named record FID 800 / SOSH / Shoemaker / 351 Northwestern Av / owner COOP with 10 unique plan vertices (11 coordinates including closure). Current snapshot coordinates exactly match the 2026-10-28 saved ArcGIS geometry.
sources.limits: Uncertified campus map polygon; no positional uncertainty or facade mapping. Attributes PU_Occupie=N, NUM_LEVELS=1 and CountOfFLO=1 conflict with current cooperative listings and two visible above-grade levels; Level_=8 and Extrution=17 have undefined semantics/units.

sources.capture_date: 2016-09-29 (date from source filename; EXIF pose/date not independently verified)
sources.role: High-resolution 3000×1687 monochrome front/adjacent-side oblique of house with Shoemaker identity sign, two above-grade levels, broad front gable, six visible sash-window bays across two rows, dark shutters, triangular cluster of three gable vents, upper corner porch/balcony and long exterior stair, partly visible foundation windows, window ACs and eaves/gutters.
sources.limits: No camera position, compass direction, scale, surveyed perspective or verified capture date beyond filename. Landscaping masks ground/wall; one face and a slice of adjacent side only. Grayscale cannot verify colors/materials.

sources.provider: First Catholic Slovak Ladies Association, FCSLA Life magazine, November 2024, printed page 18 / PDF page 18
sources.source_date: 2024-11 issue; accompanying caption says porch image from Recruitment Day but no day/date supplied
sources.role: Three reproduced campus-house photographs; caption identifies women at Shoemaker’s front porch and balcony. The exterior portions show the stair approach, upper porch/balcony, porch edge and windowed wall from a closer oblique, corroborating V1’s porch/side relationship in a later use phase.
sources.limits: Magazine reproduction rather than original camera files; no EXIF, exact camera pose/date, scale or fully unobstructed elevation. Page 18 is retained whole; no crop treated as a separate view.

sources.role: States cooperative founded in Fall 1938 as Twin Pines and moved to its present 351 Northwestern address in 1994. Distinguishes organization chronology from building chronology.
sources.limits: Institutional history does not state construction date, architect, previous use or which portions of the existing structure predate 1994.

sources.provider: Shoemaker Cooperative official current home page
sources.role: Current house page identifies 351 Northwestern, capacity of 39, ten rooms and active room/photo-tour material including Floor Two. Supports current identity/use and a second above-grade floor, not layout dimensions.
sources.limits: Page content is operator self-report; bedroom/room counts do not map to exterior openings.

sources.provider: Purdue University Fraternity, Sorority and Cooperative Life, Cooperative Houses
sources.role: Official Purdue FSCL roster lists Shoemaker among cooperative houses and links to its cooperative site.
sources.limits: Current directory listing confirms organizational presence, not building facade condition.

sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections, corporate-entity finding aid / UA 62 series 3 inventory
sources.role: Archive finding aid identifies a Shoemaker Cooperative corporate entity. UA62 inventory lists a June 1984 “Shoemaker Cooperative House [Co-op]” folder with contact sheets and negatives.
sources.limits: Digital agent page returned 403 on direct open; the finding aid describes organizational images from 1984, before the cooperative moved to 351 Northwestern in 1994. Individual images were not inspected and must not be treated as views of the current building.

sources.provider: Tippecanoe County / West Lafayette Downtown Plan, 2020
sources.role: Identifies 351 Northwestern as Shoemaker Cooperative House and lists it among important structures encouraged to be saved, rehabilitated and reused; nearby Northwestern/Grant frontages are highlighted in the plan context.
sources.limits: Planning recommendation, not proof of designation, condition, measured facade orientation or later action. The identified building is distinguished from cooperative’s former homes.
